summary: No blocking concerns. Every IR1-IR3 goal predicate has a test in its phase record that would fail if the predicate were false (IR1 T1/T2/T3/T4/T11/T13, IR2 T1/T2/T3-T5/T12, IR3 T1-T7). The code matches the results: include_roots.flatten_for_export returns None before any load when bytes_declare_includes is false, so models without includes keep their old path in both renderers, and api.judgments keeps load_model_bytes for them. Open questions from the records and the plan gate are all dispositioned. Four non-blocking gaps: (1) the plan's close predicate requires a green `uv run ruff check`, which the results report as exit 1, and no amendment or ruling covers that; (2) the delta says export now refuses fact_type_constraints-only documents with include:declaration, but no IR3 test pins it, although plan R0.6 requires each phase to pin it; (3) the file count of the union lane does not reconcile; (4) some section-11 prior-wording cells are paraphrased and one count is inconsistent.
